# Indirection controls

The bad public operation traverses three private forwarders with one fixed implementation and no transformation; changing the protocol requires walking and editing every forwarding layer. The good consumer-owned interface has a supplied implementation and a fake exercising that substitution. The bad case is a design-cost judgment, not a functional failure.

Use the lifecycle fixture's temporary-repository procedure. Keep this README
and variant names outside model inputs. Record coverage, model and prompt
versions, usage and unexpected findings; one pair cannot establish precision.
